paragraphs: Mar son of Rav Yosef habitually went to Bei Avidan; once they sought to endanger him, chapter Kol Kitvei 116a. Rav Ashi spoke to him, Elu Terefot 48b. In Rava's name, Kirah 45b; Beitzah 27b; Gittin 72b; Bava Batra 142b; Bekhorot 4a, 47a.
